# Black Hole (`blackhole`)

A lensing black hole with a glowing accretion disk.

- Type: scene (draws its own image; put it first)
- Reacts to: nothing outside itself (pure motion)
- Cost: heavy (~10.1 ms/frame at 5K on a Pro GPU)
- Built-in styles: Black Hole
